latestVersion.changelog:
Initial feature store designer release.  
- Enables design and audit of ML feature store architectures, supporting Feast, Tecton, and custom setups.
- Reviews entity definitions, feature views, data sources, materialization pipelines, serving strategies, and registry configurations.
- Detects key risks: type mismatches, cardinality issues, feature staleness, single points of failure, training-serving skew, and inefficient materialization.
- Provides actionable recommendations for configuration, freshness, serving latency, and cost optimization.
